Level 1 - Kid 15 min LLD Study plan

4-Week LLD Study Plan

A day-by-day route through this module: one week of OOP, SOLID and UML, one week of design patterns, one week of concurrency plus the ten case studies interviewers ask most, and one week of timed machine-coding mocks. If your interview is next week, there is a 7-day crash version at the end.
